title: Issues with symbol renaming
body:
### Tested versions

After #117949

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

Symbol renaming (#117949) was merged as an experimental feature and includes a scary confirmation dialog. That's because the feature has some known problems that need to be resolved before it can be considered fully usable.

This issue serves as a tracker for all problems affecting renaming. Report any issues here in the comments, or open a new issue and link here.

### Reliability

Symbol Rename is not much more than assisted search and replace (at least right now). It relies on code lookup to tick found occurrences, and if the lookup works incorrectly, wrong occurrences are going to be ticked.

- [ ] https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/117948
Causes false-negatives.
- [ ] https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/123918
Causes false-positives.
- [ ] https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/97988
Causes false-negatives and inability to start rename in some cases.
- [ ] https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/73792
Causes false-negatives or wrong renaming.
- [ ] Lambda debug names are marked as occurences of symbols with the same name
Causes false-positives.
- [ ] Can't start renaming at an enum value declaration
Also causes false-negatives, because value declaration is not recognized as occurence.
- [ ] If there is an error in the script, lookup_code doesn't work correctly until the script is saved.
Causes false-negatives.
- [ ] lookup_code only works if the script is validated
Might be related to the above. Its easier to reproduce if `text_editor/completion/idle_parse_delay` is long.
- [ ] https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/94195
Causes false-negatives when using custom separators
- [ ] Global script class renaming does not work
For some reason code lookup does not properly return global classes. A hack is used to show the renaming option, but it actually does nothing.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c97e65a-b583-40ab-b8b1-87d8e93e9738

EDIT: Seems to only happen when the class is a type hint.

- [ ] Not all virtual methods are recognized
Seems like virtual methods are found properly with 1-level inheritance, but with deeper overloads they are not recognized as the same method.
- Built-in scripts are not supported. Probably not fixable unless they are extracted from the scene somehow.

### Data loss

The risk of data loss mostly comes from the fact that renaming is performed only inside scripts. Any scene or resource data is not affected by the rename, and adding the scenes/resources to search would mean extra complication.

- [ ] Exported variables are not renamed in scenes
When you rename an exported variable, any values stored in scenes will be lost when you save them next time, unless you rename them manually. Fixing this would require parsing the scene to recognize whether an identifier is the renamed variable, which is quite difficult. As a "workaround" a warning can be show when renaming exported variable.
- [ ] Method and signal connections are not renamed in scenes
Same as above, except a warning can't be feasibly implemented (unless we assume that any method/signal is potentially connected).
- [ ] Autoloads are not renamed in project settings
This can be actually quite easy to fix, but would require an extra step for the renaming operation.
- [ ] No undo/redo support.
It's rather difficult to implement, however the editor should at least warn about it.

### Issues specific to Find in Files

Since symbol rename uses Find in Files, some of its problems also affect renaming.

- [ ] https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123931
Can put the symbol into a half-renamed state.
- [ ] Deleting `.gd` from `find_in_files_extensions` makes renaming non-functional
It makes the checkbox disappear completely from Find in Files and the search relies on it for filtering (but it shouldn't tbh).
- [ ] Renaming does not validate identifier
The new name can be invalid identifier, or have a conflicting name, resulting in all sorts of errors.
- [ ] Renaming may be applied to stale results
If the code was modified between searching and replacing, the results of replacing will be incorrect.
- [ ] Replacing lots of occurrences at once freezes the editor
Like 10000 or something.
- [ ] Replacing occurrences on the same line one at a time does not work correctly.
The columns don't get updated right.
- [ ] If a replace fails there is no error, it just prints to verbose output.
If it fails, the user should know.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a script
2. Pick an identifier
3. Right click -> Rename Symbol

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
